# Hej. Danish for English speakers

> A free, static, mobile-first web app that teaches English speakers to hear and say Danish. No accounts, no backend; progress stays in the browser's localStorage.

## WebMCP tools

Every page of this site declares WebMCP tools with `document.modelContext.registerTool`, so an agent in the visitor's browser can read what is on screen and act through the same code as the buttons. The tools appear as the visitor moves between pages; each page's `describe` tool says what is on it.

## All pages

- `describe`: Says which page is on screen, what it shows and which tools it offers.

## Home

- `get_street`: Returns the name, how many windows are lit, each lesson and the next entry to learn.
- `open_lesson`: Opens a lesson entry page by lesson id and optional position, and returns where it went.

## Lesson entry

- `get_entry`: Returns the Danish entry on screen with its English, sound guide, note and whether its window is lit.
- `hear_entry`: Speaks the Danish with a local Danish voice and returns whether it started.
- `mark_said`: Lights this entry's window, as the "I said it" button does, and returns the lit count.
- `go_to`: Goes back, to the next entry, or to the result after the last entry, and returns the new page.

## Done

- `get_result`: Returns how many windows of this lesson are lit and the praise word.
- `go_from_done`: Leaves the result page for your street, for entry 1, or for the first unlit entry, and returns the page.

## Sounds

- `get_sounds`: Returns the four sound cards with their example words and whether this device can speak Danish.
- `hear_example`: Speaks one example word with a local Danish voice, or stops it, and returns whether it started.

## Me

- `get_settings`: Returns the saved name, colour mode, windows lit and whether this browser is saving.
- `set_name`: Saves the name used in the greeting (1 to 24 characters) and returns it.
- `clear_name`: Removes the saved name and returns ok.
- `set_color_mode`: Sets the colour mode to auto, light or dark and returns it.
- `delete_progress`: Deletes every lit window when called with confirm true, and returns ok.

## Not found

- `go_to_street`: Goes back to your street and returns the page it opened.
